title: Block Mine Counter
description: This Minecraft plugin creates a public scoreboard with a top 10 ranking of the players who have mined the most blocks on the server.
body: This is a Minecraft server plugin that counts the blocks mined by each player and displays a top 10 ranking on a sidebar scoreboard visible to all users. It also includes admin commands to manually adjust player statistics and features a clean, customizable design to showcase the server’s top miners.
